title: How to read your bill
body_text:
# How to read your bill

A quick guide to finding your bill in the My Northline app and understanding each part of it.

## Find your bill in the app
1. Open the **My Northline** app on your phone.
2. Tap the **Billing** tab at the bottom of the screen.
3. Your most recent bill will appear at the top of the list.

The bill you see was created on the **statement date** - the day the bill is generated.

## What the bill shows
Your bill is divided into four clear sections:

1. **Plan charges** - This is the cost of the monthly plan you chose (for example, Northline Talk or Northline Unlimited Essentials).
2. **Add-ons** - These are extra services you have added, such as an International Day Pass or Device Protection.
3. **One-time fees** - These appear only once, like an Activation Fee for a new line or a SIM Replacement Fee.
4. **Taxes** - Government charges added to the total amount.

Each section is labeled, so you can see exactly what you are paying for.

## Pay your bill on time
1. Look for the **due date** on the bill. It is **21 days after the statement date**.
2. Make a payment before the due date to avoid the **Late Payment Fee**.
3. You can pay directly in the My Northline app, or use any other method you prefer.

Remember, Northline Wireless bills are **monthly** and are charged **in advance** for the month ahead. There are no contracts or early termination fees.

## Need more help?
If you have questions, call Northline support from your phone by dialing **611**, or from any phone at **1-800-555-0199**. Support is open **7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Central Time**, every day. You can also manage your account in the My Northline app or online at northline.example.

title: Ways to pay your bill
body_text:
# Ways to pay your bill

You can pay your Northline Wireless bill in several easy ways. Choose the method that works best for you.

## Pay with the My Northline app

The app lets you send money from your phone. It accepts credit or debit cards and bank accounts.

1. Open the My Northline app on your phone.
2. Tap **Bill Pay** on the home screen.
3. Choose the payment amount shown.
4. Select **Card** or **Bank Account** as the source.
5. Follow the prompts to enter your card number or bank routing and account numbers.
6. Confirm the payment.

Your payment is processed right away.

## Pay online at northline.example

You can also pay from any computer or tablet.

1. Go to **northline.example** in your web browser.
2. Sign in with your username and password.
3. Click **Pay My Bill**.
4. Choose **Card** or **Bank Account** and enter the required numbers.
5. Review the amount and press **Submit**.

The website saves your payment method for future use if you wish.

## Pay by phone

Dial **611** from any Northline phone. This is an automated payment line, meaning no person answers. The call is free.

1. Listen for the voice prompts.
2. Press the key for **Bill Payment**.
3. Enter your credit or debit card number or your bank account information when asked.
4. Confirm the amount and finish the call.

Your payment is applied immediately.

## Pay by mail

You may send a check if you prefer paper.

1. Write a check for the amount shown on your bill.
2. Include your account number on the memo line.
3. Mail the check to the address on your bill.

Allow **7 days** for the mailed check to arrive. Cards and bank accounts are also accepted for other methods.

## Need more help?

Call us from a Northline phone by dialing **611**, or from any phone at **1-800-555-0199**. Support is open **7 a.m. - 9 p.m. Central Time**, every day. We can walk you through any payment option.

title: Set up AutoPay
body_text:
# Set up AutoPay

Learn how to enable AutoPay so your bill is paid automatically on time.

## What AutoPay does
AutoPay is a free service. It takes the amount you owe and charges your default payment method (the card or bank account you have saved) on the bill's due date. The due date is the day each month your bill must be paid.

## Turn on AutoPay in the My Northline app
1. Open the **My Northline** app on your phone.
2. Tap **Billing** in the menu.
3. Find and tap **AutoPay**.
4. Follow the prompts to confirm that you want AutoPay turned on.

After you finish, AutoPay will run automatically each month. You do not need to do anything else.

## Change or turn off AutoPay
If you need to use a different payment method or stop AutoPay, you must act at least **2 days before** the due date.
1. Open the **My Northline** app.
2. Tap **Billing**, then **AutoPay**.
3. Choose **Edit** to change the payment method, or **Turn Off** to stop AutoPay.
4. Confirm your choice.

Make sure you complete these steps at least two days before the bill is due, otherwise the current AutoPay setting will stay in effect for that month.

## Need more help?
Call Northline Wireless support by dialing **611** from your Northline phone, or **1-800-555-0199** from any phone. Support is open **7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Central Time**, every day. You can also manage your account in the My Northline app or at **northline.example**.

title: Late payment fee
body_text:
# Late payment fee

If you miss a payment, a small fee may be added to your bill.

## What the fee is
A **Late Payment Fee** is a $5 charge. It is added when a bill is more than 10 days past its due date. The fee is a one-time amount, not a recurring charge.

## When service can be stopped
If a bill is still unpaid after **30 days**, Northline Wireless may suspend your service. Suspension means you cannot make calls, send texts, or use data until the balance is paid.

## How to ask for a waiver
You can request that the $5 fee be removed one time. Follow these steps:

1. Gather your account number and the bill that has the fee.
2. Call support:
   - Dial **611** from your Northline phone, **or**
   - Dial **1-800-555-0199** from any phone.
3. Tell the representative you want a **one-time waiver** of the Late Payment Fee.
4. The billing team will review your request. They may approve the waiver if you have a good payment history or a valid reason.

If the waiver is approved, the $5 fee will be removed from your current bill.

## How to avoid the fee in the future
- Pay your bill by the due date each month. Bills are charged in advance for the next month.
- Set up automatic payments in the **My Northline** app or at **northline.example**.
- Use email billing (free) instead of paper billing (which costs $2 per month).

## Need more help?
Call Northline Wireless support at **611** from your phone or **1-800-555-0199** from any phone. Support is open **7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Central Time**, every day. You can also manage your account in the **My Northline** app or online at **northline.example**.

title: Paper bills and email bills
body_text:
# Paper bills and email bills

title: If you cannot pay on time
body_text:
# If you cannot pay on time

If you think you will miss a bill due date, you can ask for a payment arrangement to avoid extra charges.

## What is a payment arrangement?

A payment arrangement is an agreement with Northline Wireless that lets you add up to 14 extra days to pay your bill. You must ask for it **before** the bill is due. The billing team (the group that handles money matters) has to approve the request. While the arrangement is approved, you will not be charged the $5 Late Payment Fee.

## How to request a payment arrangement

1. Call Northline support. Dial **611** from your Northline phone, or **1-800-555-0199** from any phone.
2. Tell the representative you need a payment arrangement because you cannot pay by the due date.
3. The support person will forward your request to the billing team for approval.
4. Wait for confirmation. The team will let you know if the arrangement is approved and the new payment deadline (up to 14 days later).

## What to do after approval

1. Pay the bill by the new deadline the billing team gave you.
2. Keep an eye on your account in the My Northline app or at **northline.example** to see the updated due date.
3. If you still cannot pay, contact support again before the new deadline.
4. Remember that Northline bills are monthly and are charged in advance for the next month. There are no contracts or early termination fees, so you can keep using your plan as long as you stay current.

## Need more help?

Call support at **611** from a Northline phone or **1-800-555-0199** from any phone. Help is available **7 a.m. - 9 p.m. Central Time**, every day. You can also manage your account in the My Northline app or online at **northline.example**.

title: Why your bill is higher than usual
body_text:
# Why your bill is higher than usual

Sometimes your bill looks bigger than you expect. This article explains why and how to check it.

## Common reasons for a higher bill

1. **One-time fees** - You may see the $35 Activation Fee for a new line or the $10 SIM Replacement Fee for a new SIM card. These fees are charged only once.
2. **New add-on** - Adding an extra service, such as an International Day Pass ($10 a day), Hotspot Boost, or Device Protection, adds its cost to your bill.
3. **International Day Pass usage** - If you traveled outside the United States, each day you used the phone costs $10. The charge appears only on the days you were abroad.
4. **Plan change mid-month** - Switching to a different plan part way through a month splits the cost. You pay a portion of the old plan and a portion of the new plan.
5. **Late Payment Fee** - If a bill is more than 10 days past due, a $5 fee is added.

Bills are monthly and are charged in advance for the next month. Northline Wireless has no contracts or early termination fees.

## How to review your bill

1. Open the **My Northline** app or go to **northline.example** and sign in.
2. Tap **Billing** or **Statement** to view the current month's charges.
3. Look for any line items that match the fees above (Activation, SIM Replacement, add-ons, Day Pass, Late Payment).
4. If you see a charge you do not recognize, note the date and amount for the next step.

## What to do if you see an unexpected charge

1. Verify whether you added an add-on or traveled abroad on the listed dates.
2. Check if you changed your plan during the month; the system will show the prorated amounts.
3. If the charge is still unclear, contact Northline support. Have your account number and the disputed charge ready.

## Need more help?

Call us from a Northline phone by dialing **611**, or from any phone at **1-800-555-0199**. Our support team is open **7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Central Time**, every day. You can also chat in the My Northline app or visit **northline.example** for online help.

title: Your first bill explained
body_text:
# Your first bill explained

Your first bill from Northline Wireless often looks higher than later bills. This article shows why and how to read it.

## What is on the first bill

1. **Activation Fee** - This is a one-time $35 charge for each new line you start. It covers the cost of setting up your service.
2. **Partial month charge** - You are billed for the days from the day your service starts until the first statement date. This is only part of a month.
3. **Full month ahead** - Northline bills you for the entire next month at the same time. All plans are charged in advance, so the bill includes a full month of service that you will use after the statement date.

Because the bill adds the activation fee, a partial month, and a full month ahead, the total amount is usually higher than the amount you will see on later bills.

## Why the bill is higher only the first time

- The activation fee is charged only once, so it does not appear on future bills.
- After the first bill, you will only see the regular monthly plan price (and any add-ons you keep).
- Northline Wireless has no contracts and no early termination fee, so you can change or cancel plans without extra charges after the first month.

## How to view and understand your bill

1. Open the **My Northline** app on your phone, or go to **northline.example** in a web browser.
2. Sign in with your account email and password.
3. Tap or click **Billing** or **Statements**.
4. Select the most recent statement.
5. Look for the line items labeled **Activation Fee**, **Partial Month**, and **Monthly Service**. The amounts will match the items described above.

If you see a charge you do not recognize, compare it to any add-ons you have (for example, Extra Line or Device Protection). You can add or remove add-ons in the same app under **Account Settings**.

## Need more help?

Call Northline Wireless support from your phone by dialing **611**, or from any phone at **1-800-555-0199**. Support is open **7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Central Time**, every day. You can also manage your account in the My Northline app or online at northline.example.

title: Refunds and credit balances
body_text:
# Refunds and credit balances

You may get a refund or a credit balance after a payment. This article explains the difference and how to see each in your account.

## How refunds work
A refund is money sent back to the way you originally paid.
- The carrier sends the refund to the same credit card, bank account, or other payment method you used.
- It takes **5 to 7 business days** (days that are not Saturday, Sunday, or a holiday) for the money to appear in your account.

## How credit balances work
A credit balance stays on your Northline Wireless account.
- The credit does not leave your account.
- It is automatically used to lower the amount due on your next monthly bill.
- Your bill is charged in advance for the month ahead, so the credit will apply before the new bill is generated.

## Managing refunds or credits in your account
You can view refunds and credit balances in the My Northline app or on the website at northline.example.

1. Open the **My Northline** app or go to the website and sign in.
2. Tap or click **Billing** in the menu.
3. Choose **Payment history**.
4. Look for entries labeled **Refund** or **Credit balance**.
5. If you see a refund, note the date it was processed. Expect the money in 5 to 7 business days.
6. If you see a credit balance, the amount will be shown next to **Available credit**. This amount will be applied to your next bill automatically.

If you think a refund is missing or a credit was not applied, you can contact Northline support.

## Need more help?
Call us from a Northline phone by dialing **611**.
Or call **1-800-555-0199** from any phone.
Support is open **7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Central Time**, every day.
You can also manage your account in the **My Northline** app or at **northline.example**.

title: Update your payment method
body_text:
# Update your payment method

You can add, remove, or change the card or bank account you use to pay your Northline Wireless bill. Do it in the My Northline app before your bill's due date.

## Find the payment settings
1. Open the **My Northline** app on your phone.
2. Tap the menu icon (three lines) and choose **Billing**.
3. Select **Payment methods**.

You will see a list of the cards or bank accounts currently saved.

Make sure you update an expired card **before the due date** so your bill can be paid on time.

**AutoPay** is the automatic payment system that pays your bill each month. It always uses the payment method marked as **default**.

1. In the Payment methods screen, find the method you want AutoPay to use.
2. Tap the three-dot menu next to it and select **Make default**.
3. A check mark will appear, showing this method is now the default for AutoPay.

If you add a new method and want AutoPay to use it, repeat these steps to make it the default.

Call Northline Wireless support from your phone by dialing **611**, or from any phone at **1-800-555-0199**. Support is open **7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Central Time**, every day. You can also manage your account online at **northline.example**.

title: Taxes on your bill
body_text:
# Taxes on your bill

A short look at why taxes appear on your Northline Wireless bill and what can make them change.

## What taxes are on your bill
Taxes are charges that the federal, state, and local governments require. They are not fees that Northline adds. The tax amount depends on the address where you receive service. If you live in a city that has a sales tax, that tax will be on your bill. If your state has a communications tax, that will also appear.

## Why taxes can change
When you move to a new address, the government rates may be different. Changing the billing address in your account can cause the tax amount to go up or down. The change happens the first month after the new address is saved.

## How to see the taxes on your bill
1. Open the **My Northline** app on your phone, or go to **northline.example** on a computer.
2. Sign in with your username and password.
3. Tap or click **Billing** from the main menu.
4. Look for the line labeled **Taxes**. It will show the total tax amount for that month.

If you prefer a paper bill, the tax amount will be printed on the statement you receive in the mail.

## How to update your billing address
1. Open the app or website and sign in.
2. Choose **Account Settings**.
3. Select **Billing Address** and enter your new street, city, state, and ZIP code.
4. Save the changes.

Your next bill will use the new address to calculate taxes.

## Need more help?
Call us from any Northline phone by dialing **611**, or from any other phone at **1-800-555-0199**. Our support team is open **7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Central Time**, every day. You can also manage your account in the My Northline app or at northline.example.

title: Your billing date and due date
body_text:
# Your billing date and due date

Your monthly bill is created on the same day each month. Payment is due 21 days after that date.

## What is a statement date?
The statement date is the day your bill is generated.
- It is the same calendar day every month.
- The bill shows the amount you will pay for the next month.
- This date starts your billing cycle, which is the period the bill covers.

## When is your payment due?
Your due date is 21 days after the statement date.
- You must pay by this date to avoid a late payment fee.
- The fee is $5 and is added only if the bill is more than 10 days past due.
- Paying on time keeps your service active and avoids extra charges.

## How to change your statement date
You can ask Northline support to move your statement date, but only once every 12 months.

1. Open the **My Northline** app or go to **northline.example** and sign in.
2. Tap **Billing** and look for **Statement Date**.
3. Note the current date, then tap **Request Change**.
4. Follow the prompts to pick a new date.
5. Submit the request.

If you prefer to speak with a person, call:

1. Dial **611** from any Northline phone, or **1-800-555-0199** from any other phone.
2. Tell the representative you want to change your statement date.
3. They will confirm the new date and let you know when the change takes effect.

Remember, you can only make this change once per year.

## Need more help?
Call Northline Wireless support at **611** (Northline phone) or **1-800-555-0199** (any phone).
Support is open **7 a.m. - 9 p.m. Central Time**, every day.
You can also manage your billing in the **My Northline** app or at **northline.example**.

title: Dispute a charge
body_text:
# Dispute a charge

If you see a charge you think is wrong, you can ask Northline Wireless to look at it.

## When to start a dispute
- You must contact support within **60 days** of the date on your statement.
- Keep paying the rest of the bill while the dispute is being reviewed.
- The billing team will check your case in **3 to 5 business days**.

## How to contact support
1. Open the **My Northline** app or go to **northline.example** and sign in to your account.
2. Find the "Help" or "Contact Us" section.
3. Choose one of these ways to call:
   - Dial **611** from your Northline phone.
   - Call **1-800-555-0199** from any phone.
4. When you reach a representative, tell them you want to **dispute a charge** and give the date of the statement.
5. The agent will ask for details about the charge and may request a copy of the bill.

Support is open **7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Central Time**, every day.

## What happens after you file
- The billing team reviews your request within **3 to 5 business days**.
- They will let you know the result by phone, email, or a note in the app.
- If the charge is found to be an error, it will be removed from your bill.
- If the charge is correct, you will continue to pay it as usual.

Remember, your monthly bill is charged in advance for the next month, so the disputed amount will affect the upcoming bill, not the one you already paid.

## Need more help?
Call **611** from a Northline phone or **1-800-555-0199** from any phone. Support is available **7 a.m. - 9 p.m. Central Time**, every day. You can also manage your account in the **My Northline** app or at **northline.example**.

title: Service suspended for non-payment
body_text:
# Service suspended for non-payment

If you miss a payment, your service may stop. This article explains why it happens and how to get it back.

## Why your service can be suspended

Northline Wireless pauses service when a bill is **30 days past due**. "Past due" means you have not paid the amount that was due on the bill. While your service is paused, you can still call **911** for emergencies. There is no extra charge to reconnect.

## How to restore service

You can restore service by paying the amount you owe. Follow these steps:

1. Open the **My Northline** app on your phone or go to **northline.example** on a computer.
2. Sign in with your account name and password.
3. Find the **Bill** or **Payments** section.
4. Choose the option to **Pay Now** and enter a payment method (credit card, debit card, or bank account).
5. Confirm the payment amount and submit.

After the payment is processed, service should be back within **1 hour**. No reconnection fee will be added.

## What you can still do while suspended

Even when your regular service is paused, you can still dial **911** for emergency assistance. All other calls, texts, and data will not work until you pay the past-due balance.

## Need more help?

If you have questions or need help paying, call Northline support:

- Dial **611** from your Northline phone, or
- Call **1-800-555-0199** from any phone.

Support is open **7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Central Time**, every day. You can also manage your account in the My Northline app or at northline.example.

title: Compare Northline plans
body_text:
# Compare Northline plans

A quick look at all eight Northline Wireless plans helps you see which one fits your needs.

## What each plan includes

- **Northline Talk** - $15 per month - 0 GB data. Unlimited talk and text. No mobile data.
- **Northline Starter 1** - $20 per month - 1 GB data. Unlimited talk and text. Good for email and maps.
- **Northline Everyday 5** - $25 per month - 5 GB data. Unlimited talk and text.
- **Northline Plus 10** - $35 per month - 10 GB data. Unlimited talk and text. Includes 2 GB hotspot data and calls to Canada and Mexico.
- **Northline Extra 20** - $45 per month - 20 GB data. Unlimited talk and text. Includes 5 GB hotspot data and calls to Canada and Mexico.
- **Northline Unlimited Essentials** - $50 per month - unlimited data. Unlimited talk and text. Includes 5 GB hotspot data and calls to Canada and Mexico. Speed may slow after 35 GB used in a month.
- **Northline Unlimited Premium** - $65 per month - unlimited data. Unlimited talk and text. Includes 30 GB hotspot data and calls and roaming in Canada and Mexico. Speed may slow after 60 GB used in a month.
- **Northline Two-Line Unlimited** - $80 per month - unlimited data shared by two lines. Unlimited talk and text for both lines. Includes 10 GB hotspot data and calls to Canada and Mexico.

## How to pick the right plan

1. Write down how much data you usually need each month.
2. Match that amount to the plan that offers at least that much data.
3. If you travel to Canada or Mexico, choose a plan that lists international calls.
4. If you need hotspot data for other devices, look at the hotspot amount listed for each plan.

## How to change or add a plan

1. Open the **My Northline** app or go to **northline.example** and sign in.
2. Tap **Plan & Services** and then **Change Plan**.
3. Select the new plan you want and confirm your choice.
4. Your new plan starts on the first day of the next billing cycle.

## Need more help?

Call us from any phone at **1-800-555-0199** or dial **611** from your Northline phone. We are open 7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Central Time, every day. You can also manage your account in the My Northline app or online.

title: Choose the right plan
body_text:
# Choose the right plan

Find a plan that fits what you do most on your phone. Look at your usage first, then pick the best match.

## 1. Check how much you use today
1. Open the **My Northline** app on your phone, or go to northline.example on a computer.
2. Tap **Usage**.
3. Note the amount of talk minutes, text messages, and data (the amount of internet you have used).

If you see only a few minutes and texts and no data, you probably need a talk-only plan. If you see a lot of data, look at the higher-data options.

## 2. Match your needs to a plan
| What you do most | Recommended plan(s) | Why it fits |
|---|---|---|
| Calls and texts only | **Northline Talk** - $15/month, no data. | Gives unlimited talk and text without paying for data you don't use. |

| Everyday browsing (web, social media) | **Northline Everyday 5** - $25/month, 5 GB data **or** **Northline Plus 10** - $35/month, 10 GB data + 2 GB hotspot. | More data for regular internet use; Plus 10 also lets you share a hotspot. |
| Video and music streaming | **Northline Extra 20** - $45/month, 20 GB data **or** any **Unlimited** plan. | Enough data for streaming; unlimited plans give you no data caps. |
| Two people sharing a phone line | **Northline Two-Line Unlimited** - $80/month, unlimited data for both lines. | One bill for two lines, each gets unlimited data. |

*Hotspot* means your phone can act like a Wi-Fi router for other devices.

## 3. Change to a new plan
1. Open the **My Northline** app or log in at northline.example.
2. Choose **Change Plan** from the menu.
3. Select the plan you want from the list above.
4. Confirm the change. Your new plan starts at the beginning of the next billing month (bills are paid in advance).

Northline Wireless has no contracts and no early termination fee. Your bill will be monthly.

## Need more help?
Call us from a Northline phone by dialing **611**, or from any phone at **1-800-555-0199**. Support is open **7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Central Time**, every day. You can also manage your account in the My Northline app or at northline.example.

title: Change your plan
body_text:
# Change your plan
You can move to a different Northline Wireless plan whenever you need.

## What happens when you change a plan
A **plan change** means you pick a new monthly service option. The new plan starts on the next **billing date** - the day your monthly bill is due. There is no fee for changing plans. Northline Wireless does not have contracts or early-termination fees, so you can switch at any time. The account team will apply the change for you.

## Change your plan using the My Northline app
1. Open the **My Northline** app on your phone.
2. Tap **Plan** in the menu.
3. Choose the plan you want from the list.
4. Confirm your selection.
5. The app will tell you that the new plan will begin on your next billing date.

## Change your plan by contacting support
1. Call **611** from any Northline phone, or **1-800-555-0199** from any other phone.
2. Tell the representative you want to change your plan.
3. Verify that you are the **account owner** (the person who set up the account).
4. State which plan you would like to switch to.
5. The support team will note your request and the account team will make the change.

title: How unlimited data works
body_text:
# How unlimited data works

Unlimited data lets you use as much data as you need each month. The speed may change after you reach a set amount.

## What "unlimited" really means
"Unlimited" means there is no hard cap on how many gigabytes (GB) you can download or upload. You can keep using data until the end of the month. However, the network may lower (throttle) your speed after you use a lot of data in one billing cycle.

## When your speed may slow
- **Unlimited Essentials** - After you use 35 GB of data in a month, the network may slow your speed.
- **Unlimited Premium** - After you use 60 GB of data in a month, the network may slow your speed.

The slower speed is only for the rest of that billing cycle. On the next billing date, your speed returns to normal automatically.

## Hotspot data is separate
A hotspot lets you share your phone's connection with other devices. The hotspot allowance does not count toward the regular data limit.

- Essentials gives you **5 GB** of hotspot data each month.
- Premium gives you **30 GB** of hotspot data each month.

If you use more hotspot data than the allowance, the hotspot speed may be reduced, but your regular data limit is unchanged.

## How to check your usage
1. Open the **My Northline** app on your phone, or go to **northline.example** in a web browser.
2. Sign in with your Northline account.
3. Tap **Data Usage** to see how many GB you have used for regular data and for hotspot data.
4. If you are close to the limit, consider using Wi-Fi or limiting high-bandwidth apps until the next billing date.

## Need more help?

2. Scroll down and tap **About phone** (the name may vary slightly).
3. Look for a line that says **IMEI** or **IMEI number**.
4. Record the 15-digit number shown.

## Check the original box

If you still have the box your phone came in, look for a sticker on the outside. The sticker lists the IMEI along with other details. Write down the number exactly as printed.

title: SIM cards and eSIM
body_text:
# SIM cards and eSIM

A SIM card is a tiny chip that connects your phone to your Northline Wireless account. An eSIM does the same job but is built into the phone, so no removable chip is needed.

## What is a SIM card?

A SIM (Subscriber Identity Module) card is a small plastic card with a metal chip.
- The chip stores your phone number and account information.
- You insert it into the SIM slot of your phone.
- If the card is lost or damaged, you can ask Northline for a replacement. The replacement costs $10.

## What is an eSIM?

An eSIM (embedded SIM) is a chip that is already inside the phone's hardware.
- It works like a regular SIM but you never handle a physical card.
- Because it is built-in, there is no extra cost to replace it. eSIM replacements are free.
- Switching from a physical SIM to an eSIM does not charge you.

## How to switch to eSIM (free)

1. Open the **My Northline** app on your phone.
2. Tap **Account** then **Device Settings**.
3. Choose **Switch to eSIM**.
4. Follow the on-screen prompts to download the eSIM profile.
5. When the download finishes, the app will ask you to restart the phone.
6. After the phone restarts, your line will be active on the eSIM.

If you have trouble, you can call support for help.

## How to get a replacement SIM card

1. Call Northline support at **611** from your Northline phone, or **1-800-555-0199** from any phone.
2. Tell the representative you need a new SIM because yours is lost, broken, or not working.
3. The representative will verify your identity and place the $10 replacement order.
4. You will receive the new SIM by mail within a few days.
5. When it arrives, insert it into your phone's SIM slot and restart the device.

## Need more help?

Call Northline support at **611** (from a Northline phone) or **1-800-555-0199** (any phone). Support is open daily from **7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Central Time**. You can also manage your account in the **My Northline** app or at **northline.example**.

body_text:
# Switch to eSIM
You can move your service to an eSIM without paying a fee. The old SIM card will stop working once the eSIM is active.

## Before you start
1. Make sure your phone is connected to Wi-Fi. The eSIM download needs an internet connection.
2. Have the My Northline app installed. You can find the app in your phone's app store.
3. Keep your current SIM card handy until the switch is finished.

## How to switch in the My Northline app
1. Open the My Northline app and sign in to your account.
2. Tap **Devices** in the menu. This screen shows the phones linked to your account.
3. Choose the phone you want to convert.
4. Tap **Switch to eSIM**.
5. Follow the on-screen prompts. The app will download the eSIM profile to your phone.
6. When the download finishes, the app will confirm that the eSIM is active.

The whole process is free. Do not worry about any charge for the eSIM conversion.

## What happens after the switch
1. Your old physical SIM card will stop working as soon as the eSIM is active. You can remove it safely.
2. Your phone will now use the embedded SIM (eSIM) to connect to Northline Wireless. An eSIM is a small chip built into the phone that stores your carrier information, so you do not need a removable card.
3. If you need to move the service to another device later, you can repeat the steps in the app.

## Need more help?
Call Northline Wireless support at **611** from your Northline phone, or **1-800-555-0199** from any phone. Support is open **7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Central Time**, every day. You can also manage your account in the My Northline app or online at northline.example.

title: Set up voicemail
body_text:
# Set up voicemail

You can set up voicemail on your Northline Wireless phone in a few simple steps.

## Start voicemail setup
1. Open the phone's keypad.
2. Press and hold the **1** key until you hear a beep.
   - Holding the key tells the phone to call your voicemail service.

## Choose a voicemail PIN
1. When prompted, pick a **PIN** (Personal Identification Number).
2. Your PIN must be between **4 and 6 digits** long.
3. Write the PIN down or remember it, because you will need it each time you check voicemail.

## Record a greeting
1. After entering your PIN, the system will ask you to record a greeting.
2. Speak clearly into the microphone and say how callers should leave a message.
3. When you are finished, follow the prompts to save the greeting.

## What your mailbox can hold
- Your voicemail **mailbox** can store up to **30 messages**.
- Each message is kept for **30 days** before it is automatically deleted.

If you need to change your PIN or greeting later, repeat the steps above.

## Need more help?
Call Northline Wireless support by dialing **611** from your Northline phone, or **1-800-555-0199** from any phone. Support is open **7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Central Time**, every day. You can also manage voicemail settings in the My Northline app or online at northline.example.

title: Move contacts and photos to a new phone
body_text:
# Move contacts and photos to a new phone
You can keep your contacts and pictures when you switch to a new phone. Follow these steps to move them safely.

## Prepare your old phone
1. Open the **Settings** app.
2. Find **Accounts** (this is where you link email or cloud services).
3. Tap your **Google** account if you use Android, or **Apple** account if you use iPhone.
4. Turn on **Sync** for **Contacts** - this copies your address book to the cloud.
5. Locate **Photo backup** (sometimes called **Google Photos** or **iCloud Photos**) and turn it on.
6. Make sure the phone is connected to Wi-Fi. Photo backup can take an hour or more on Wi-Fi, especially if you have many pictures.

## Set up your new phone
1. Turn on the new phone and follow the initial setup prompts.
2. When asked, sign in with the **same Google** or **Apple** account you used on the old phone.
3. In **Settings > Accounts**, enable **Sync** for **Contacts**. Your address book will download automatically.
4. Open the photo backup app (Google Photos or Photos). It will begin downloading the pictures you backed up. Wait until the download finishes; this may also take some time on Wi-Fi.

## Verify everything moved
1. Open your contacts app and scroll through the list. Make sure the names you expect are there.
2. Open the photo backup app and look for recent pictures. If any are missing, keep the phone connected to Wi-Fi and give it more time.
3. If you see any gaps, repeat the sync step on the old phone and then check the new phone again.

## Need more help?
Call Northline Wireless support at **611** from your Northline phone, or **1-800-555-0199** from any phone. Support is open **7 a.m. - 9 p.m. Central Time**, every day. You can also manage your account in the My Northline app or at northline.example.

title: Wi-Fi calling
body_text:
# Wi-Fi calling

Wi-Fi calling lets your phone place calls and send texts over a Wi-Fi network when the cellular signal is weak. It works the same as a regular call, but uses the internet instead of the carrier's towers.

## What Wi-Fi calling does

- It uses Wi-Fi (wireless internet) to connect your voice and text messages.
- You can still call and text any United States phone number for free, even if you are outside the United States.
- The feature works on most smartphones that support it.

## Turn on Wi-Fi calling

1. Open the **Settings** app on your phone.
2. Find the section called **Phone** or **Connections** (the name may vary by device).
3. Tap **Wi-Fi Calling**.
4. Switch the toggle to **On**.
5. When prompted, enter your **emergency address** (the address where you live). This address is used by emergency services if you call 911 over Wi-Fi.

## Why you need an emergency address

An emergency address is the location you give to 911 services. When you call 911 using Wi-Fi, the network does not know your exact location, so the address you enter helps responders find you.

## Free calls to United States numbers

- All calls and texts to U.S. phone numbers are free while you use Wi-Fi calling.
- This includes calls made while you are traveling abroad, as long as you have a Wi-Fi connection.

## Need more help?

If you have questions or run into problems, call Northline Wireless support:

- Dial **611** from your Northline phone, or **1-800-555-0199** from any phone.
- Support is open **7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Central Time**, every day.

You can also manage settings in the **My Northline** app or visit **northline.example** for online help.

title: Bring your own phone
body_text:
# Bring your own phone

You can use a phone you already own with Northline Wireless. Follow these steps to make sure it works and to start service.

## Check if your phone works

1. Find your phone's IMEI. The IMEI is the unique 15-digit number that identifies your phone. You can see it by dialing **\*#06#** or by looking in the phone's Settings under **About phone**.
2. Open a web browser on any device and go to **northline.example/byod**.
3. Enter the IMEI in the box and press **Check**. The site will tell you if the phone is compatible with Northline's network.
4. If the phone is not compatible, you will need a different device.

## Prepare your phone for activation

1. Make sure the phone is **unlocked**. An unlocked phone is not locked to a previous carrier and can accept a new SIM card. If your phone is still locked, contact the old carrier to request an unlock.
2. Back up any important data (photos, contacts, messages) before you change the SIM. You can use the phone's built-in backup tool or a computer.

## Activate your new line

1. Order a new SIM card from Northline or use an eSIM if your phone supports it.
2. When the SIM arrives, insert it into the phone. If you use an eSIM, follow the on-screen instructions to add the eSIM profile.
3. Open the **My Northline** app or log in at **northline.example**.
4. Choose the plan you want and follow the prompts to finish activation.
5. Pay the one-time **$35 Activation Fee** for the new line. This fee is charged only once per line.

Your phone should now be ready to make calls, send texts, and use data according to the plan you selected.

## Need more help?

Call Northline support from any Northline phone by dialing **611**, or from any other phone at **1-800-555-0199**. Support is open daily from 7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Central Time. You can also manage your account in the My Northline app or at **northline.example**.

title: Unlock a Northline phone
body_text:

Call Northline support at **611** from your Northline phone or **1-800-555-0199** from any phone. Support is open daily from **7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Central Time**. You can also manage your request in the My Northline app or at northline.example.

title: Use your phone as a hotspot
body_text:
# Use your phone as a hotspot

You can share your phone's data with a laptop, tablet, or another phone by turning on the hotspot feature.

## What a hotspot does
A hotspot lets your phone act like a small Wi-Fi router. It sends the data from your mobile plan to other devices. The data used this way comes from the hotspot allowance in your plan.

## Turn on the hotspot
1. Open **Settings** on your phone.
2. Find **Network & Internet** (or **Connections**) and tap **Hotspot & tethering**.
3. Tap **Wi-Fi hotspot** to turn it on.
4. Choose **Set up hotspot** (or **Configure hotspot**).
5. Enter a **password** that is at least 8 characters. Write it down so you can give it to the device that will connect.
6. Save the settings. Your phone now broadcasts a Wi-Fi network with the name you see on the screen.

## How hotspot data works
- Each plan includes a set amount of hotspot data. For example, the **Northline Plus 10** plan gives 2 GB of hotspot data, while **Northline Unlimited Premium** gives 30 GB.
- When you use hotspot data, it is taken from that allowance.
- If you reach the limit, the hotspot will stop working until the next billing date.
- You can keep hotspot access by adding the **Hotspot Boost** add-on. It adds 10 GB of hotspot data each month. You can add it in the My Northline app or at northline.example.

## Need more help?
Call us from a Northline phone by dialing **611**, or from any phone at **1-800-555-0199**. Our support team is open **7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Central Time**, every day. You can also manage your hotspot settings and add Hotspot Boost in the My Northline app.

title: Block unwanted calls
body_text:
# Block unwanted calls

You can stop a specific number from calling you again and let Northline Call Filter warn you about likely spam calls.

## Block a number from the recent calls list

1. Open the Phone app on your device.
2. Tap the **Recent** or **Call History** tab to see the list of recent calls.
3. Find the number you want to block.
4. Tap the **i** (information) icon next to that number.
5. Choose **Block number** (or **Add to block list**).
6. Confirm the block when asked.

The blocked number will no longer be able to call or text you. You can unblock it later in the Phone app's settings if you change your mind.

## Turn on Northline Call Filter

Northline Call Filter is a free feature that helps you see which calls might be spam. *Spam* means unwanted or suspicious calls, often from marketers or scammers.

1. Open the **My Northline** app.
2. Tap **Security** in the menu.
3. Make sure the switch for **Northline Call Filter** is turned on.

When the filter is active, incoming calls that look like spam will show a label such as "Spam" or "Possible scam" on your screen. You can then decide to ignore or block the call.

## Extra tips to keep unwanted calls away

- Review the blocked list regularly and remove any numbers you no longer need to block.
- If a call is labeled spam, do not answer. Let it go to voicemail.
- Report persistent spam numbers to Northline by using the **Report Spam** button in the Call Filter screen.

## Need more help?

Call us from your Northline phone by dialing **611**, or from any phone at **1-800-555-0199**. Our support team is available **7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Central Time**, every day. You can also manage settings in the My Northline app or visit **northline.example**.

title: Back up your phone
body_text:
# Back up your phone

Backing up saves a copy of your contacts, photos, apps and settings. A backup lets you restore everything quickly on a new or replacement phone.

## Why you should back up

A backup stores your data in the cloud (online storage that you can reach from any device). If your phone is lost, broken, or you get a new phone, you can bring back your information without re-entering everything. Backing up also protects against accidental deletion.

## Back up an iPhone with iCloud

iCloud is Apple's cloud service that keeps a copy of your phone data.

1. Connect your iPhone to a charger.
2. Make sure you are on a Wi-Fi network (cellular data is not used).
3. Open **Settings** and tap your name at the top.
4. Choose **iCloud**.
5. Turn on **iCloud Backup**.
6. Tap **Back Up Now**.
7. Wait until the process finishes. You will see a confirmation with the date and time of the last backup.

Your iPhone will now back up automatically each night while it is charging and on Wi-Fi.

## Back up an Android phone with Google backup

Google backup saves your apps, call history, contacts, and more to your Google account.

1. Plug your Android phone into a charger.
2. Connect to a Wi-Fi network.
3. Open the **Settings** app.
4. Scroll to **System** (or **General Management**) and tap **Backup**.
5. Turn on **Back up to Google Drive** (Google's cloud storage).
6. Tap **Back up now** and wait for the confirmation message.

Your Android will continue to back up daily when it is charging and connected to Wi-Fi.

## Need more help?

Call Northline Wireless support at **611** from your Northline phone, or **1-800-555-0199** from any phone. Support is open **7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Central Time**, every day. You can also manage your account in the My Northline app or at northline.example.

title: Update your phone's software
body_text:
# Update your phone's software

Keeping your phone's software up to date helps it run smoothly and stay safe.

## Why you should update
A software update is a new version of the phone's operating system. It fixes known problems and adds security protection. Installing updates reduces the chance that bad software can harm your phone or your personal information.

## Prepare your phone
1. Make sure your phone is connected to a Wi-Fi network. Wi-Fi is faster and does not use your mobile data.
2. Check that the battery level is at least 50 %. You can see the battery percentage at the top of the screen. If the battery is low, plug the charger in before you start.

These steps help the update finish without interruption.

## Run the update
1. Open **Settings** - the gear-shaped icon on your home screen or in the app drawer.
2. Scroll down and tap **Software update**. This screen shows whether a new version is ready.
3. Tap **Download and install** (or a similar button). The phone will begin downloading the update over Wi-Fi.
4. When the download is complete, the phone will ask you to restart. Confirm the restart.
5. The phone will turn off and then turn back on while it installs the update. This may take several minutes. Do not turn off the phone or remove the charger during this time.

After the restart, the phone will be running the latest software. You may see a brief message that the update was successful.

## Need more help?
Call Northline Wireless support by dialing **611** from your Northline phone, or **1-800-555-0199** from any phone. Support is available **7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Central Time**, every day.

title: Return or exchange a device
body_text:

You can send back a Northline Wireless phone if it does not work for you. The process is simple and has no extra fees.

## When you can return a device

- The phone must be in its original condition, meaning no damage and all original accessories (charger, case, etc.) must be included.

3. The support agent will give you a return label and instructions for packing the phone.
4. Pack the phone securely, attach the label, and drop it off at the indicated carrier location.

## What happens after you send it back
- Northline will receive the phone and check that it is in original condition.
- Once the return is approved, a refund will be issued to the payment method you used.
- The refund is processed **5 to 7 business days** after Northline receives the device.

## Need more help?
If you have questions, call support at **611** (Northline phone) or **1-800-555-0199** (any phone). Support is open **7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Central Time**, every day. You can also manage your return in the **My Northline app** or online at **northline.example**.

title: Create your online account
body_text:
# Create your online account

You can set up a Northline Wireless account on the web or in the My Northline app. An account lets you view bills, change plans, and add services.

## Why you need an account

Northline Wireless does not require a contract or an early termination fee. Your bill is charged each month in advance. With an account you can see your monthly bill, update your contact information, and add or remove phone lines.

## Register on the website

1. Open a web browser and go to **northline.example/register**.
2. Type the phone number you use with Northline Wireless.
3. Tap **Send code**. The system will send a **one-time code** - a short number sent by text that proves you own the phone.
4. Enter the one-time code in the box that appears. The code is only valid for **10 minutes**; after that you must request a new one.
5. Follow the prompts to create a password and finish the registration.

## Register using the My Northline app

1. Download the **My Northline** app from your device's app store.
2. Open the app and tap **Create account**.
3. Enter your Northline phone number and tap **Send code**.
4. When you receive the text, type the one-time code into the app. Remember, the code expires after 10 minutes.
5. Choose a password, agree to the terms, and tap **Complete**.

## Managing your account

After you sign in, you can view your monthly bill, change your plan, or add add-ons like Device Protection. All changes are saved in the My Northline app or at **northline.example**. You do not need a contract to make changes, and there is no early termination fee.

## Need more help?

Call Northline support from your Northline phone by dialing **611**, or from any phone at **1-800-555-0199**. Support is open **7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Central Time**, every day.

title: Reset your password
body_text:
# Reset your password

If you forget your password, you can set a new one using a code sent to your phone.

## Start the reset process

1. Open the sign-in page on the My Northline app or at northline.example.
2. Tap **Forgot password**. This link tells the system you need a new password.
3. The system will send a **one-time code** (a short number you can use only once) to the phone number on your account.

The code is sent by text message and is only valid for 10 minutes.

## Enter the code and create a new password

1. When you receive the text, return to the sign-in screen.
2. Type the one-time code exactly as it appears.
3. If the code is still valid, you will be asked to type a new password.
4. Choose a password you can remember but that is hard for others to guess. Use letters, numbers, and symbols.
5. Confirm the new password by typing it again, then tap **Save**.

If you enter the wrong code five times, the system will lock your account for 30 minutes. After the lock period ends, you can try again.

## What to do if you are locked out

1. Wait 30 minutes before trying another reset.
2. During the wait, you can still use your phone for calls and texts.
3. After 30 minutes, repeat the steps in **Start the reset process**.

If you cannot receive the text message, make sure your phone has signal and that the number on file is correct. You can update your contact information in the My Northline app or on northline.example once you are signed in.

## Need more help?

Call Northline Wireless support by dialing **611** from your Northline phone, or **1-800-555-0199** from any phone. Support is open **7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Central Time**, every day.

title: Your account PIN
body_text:
# Your account PIN

A PIN is a short secret number you use to prove who you are. Northline Wireless uses a 4- to 6-digit PIN for account security.

## What is an account PIN?

Your account PIN (Personal Identification Number) is a 4 to 6 digit code.
Support agents ask for it when they need to confirm your identity on a phone call.
Northline will never call, text, or email you to ask for your PIN. If anyone asks for it in that way, it is a scam.

## Set or change your PIN in the My Northline app

You can create or update your PIN at any time from the My Northline app.

1. Open the My Northline app on your phone.
2. Tap **Menu** (the three lines) and choose **Security**.
3. Select **PIN** or **Change PIN**.
4. Enter a new 4- to 6-digit number you can remember.
5. Confirm the new number by typing it again.
6. Tap **Save** or **Done**.

The app will confirm that your PIN has been set. Keep the number private.

## Keep your PIN safe

- Do not write your PIN on a piece of paper that others can see.
- Do not share the PIN with anyone, even family members.
- If you think someone may know your PIN, change it right away using the steps above.
- Remember that Northline support will never ask for your PIN by phone, text, or email.

## Need more help?

Call Northline support by dialing **611** from your Northline phone, or **1-800-555-0199** from any phone. Support is open **7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Central Time**, every day. You can also manage your account in the My Northline app or at **northline.example**.

title: Add an authorized user
body_text:
# Add an authorized user

You can let someone help you manage your Northline Wireless account without giving them full control.

## Who can be an authorized user
An **authorized user** is a person you trust to ask about your bill and get technical help. They cannot cancel your service, move a phone number to another account, or change who owns the account. This keeps your account safe while still letting another person assist you.

## How to add an authorized user
You add the person from the My Northline app. Follow these steps:

1. Open the My Northline app on your phone.
2. Tap the **Security** menu. (Security is the part of the app that protects your account.)
3. Choose **Authorized users**.
4. Tap **Add a user** and enter the person's name and email address.
5. Confirm the addition by tapping **Save** or **Done**.

The new authorized user will receive an email invitation. They must accept it before they can view billing information or request technical help.

## What an authorized user can do
After you add them, the authorized user can:

- Look at your current bill and ask questions about charges.
- Call Northline support for technical help with your device or service.

They cannot:

- Cancel your service.
- Transfer a phone number to a different account.
- Change the account owner's name or contact details.

These limits protect your account while still giving you extra help.

## Need more help?
Call us from any Northline phone by dialing **611**, or from any other phone at **1-800-555-0199**. Our support team is open **7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Central Time**, every day. We're ready to answer any questions you have.

title: Update your address or email

Learn how to change the address or email linked to your Northline Wireless account.

title: Bring your number to Northline
body_text:
# Bring your number to Northline
You can move your existing phone number to Northline Wireless. Follow these steps to keep your service running and avoid delays.

Northline does not require a contract and there is no early termination fee. Your bill is monthly and is charged in advance for the next month. You can manage your account anytime in the My Northline app or at northline.example.
